sample_unit: pilot users (physicians, nurses, nurse practitioners, medical assistants); 52 survey respondents

links.outcome: Rate of AI draft use and extent of editing of drafts before sending
links.effect: Mean rate of starting a reply with an ART draft was 20.2%; 40% of replies showed little to no editing of the draft. Drafts sometimes contained incorrect or inappropriate content (34.9%, n=15).
links.quote: The mean rate of starting with an ART draft was 20.2%, and 40% of replies exhibited little to no editing of the draft.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of real deployment of LLM-generated draft replies to patient portal messages (Epic ART) measuring adoption, clinician editing, and satisfaction, but does not compare or evaluate a specific guardrail practice.
